description: baseline: LightGBM binary classifier with Optuna TPE search (60 trials, 5-fold stratified CV) over num_leaves, learning_rate, min_child_samples, feature_fraction, bagging, L1/L2, max_depth — chosen because N=500 with 11 mixed features is squarely in Tier A where gradient boosting dominates; missing indicators added for high-miss columns, categorical features passed natively to LightGBM.
